page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head above it. Section heading "SECT. X." centred. Marginal note in the right margin beside the first lines of the second paragraph ("Casus 48"). Catchword "nem" at the right below the text, with gathering signature "O" at the foot.

main_text.l: tendebat se obligare. Ast ubi contra
promissio ipsa fundatur in debito aliquo
quia is cui fit promissio jus habet eam
ut ex ipsius potius mente & interpreta-
tione, quàm ex promittentis sensu, de
Casus Tertius est, ubi deferens jura-
mentum sensus ambigui, id tantum po-
stulat ut in ea verba juretur; permittit
gere. Dico, merito f[?] spectum esse de-
bere latentis alicujus doli mali, & pro-
inde recusandum esse viro pio & pru-
denti oblatum sub tali conditione jura-
ctu ipsius Juramenti, in quo requiritur

page.notes: Right margin note "Casus 48" placed beside the line "jura-mentum". Left margin has only faint marks at line starts (edge/show-through), not transcribed. "f[?] spectum" is uncertain: the letter before "spectum" is unclear and may be a stray long s. Line-end hyphens kept as printed. The "ct" in "Prælectio" and "Præleētio" is a ligature in print; written as "ct". Words with long s were normalised to plain s, and "fe" and "fi" are written as "se" and "si".
